ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation DreamJob' — trojanized signed binary side-load from user-writable path after archive/ISO extraction
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus DreamJob initial-access chain: a victim opens a LinkedIn-themed ISO/ZIP 'coding challenge', extracts a legitimately-signed binary (PuTTY, TightVNC, AmazonAssessment, FCCCallTester, IconCache, ColorUI, MT4, etc.) into Downloads/Desktop/Temp, that binary runs and side-loads an attacker-controlled DLL co-located in the same directory, then beacons over TLS. Mandiant/Microsoft/ESET have repeatedly attributed this exact ISO→signed-binary→side-loaded-DLL chain to Lazarus / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima (ZetaNile, Comebacker, LightlessCan, MISTPEN payloads).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" AND Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Desktop\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("putty.exe","tightvnc.exe","amazonassessment.exe","amazonvncviewer.exe","iconcache.exe","fcccalltester.exe","mxgetinfo.exe","airbusassessment.exe","boeingassessment.exe","lockheedassessment.exe","colorui.exe","sysenv.exe","mt4.exe","wsapconfg.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| join type=inner host process_id [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category="external" AND All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,8080,8443) by host All_Traffic.process_id All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
    | rename dest as remote_ip
  ]
| table firstTime host user process_name image sha256 parent remote_ip dest_port
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LureBinaries = dynamic(["putty.exe","tightvnc.exe","amazonassessment.exe","amazonvncviewer.exe","iconcache.exe","fcccalltester.exe","mxgetinfo.exe","airbusassessment.exe","boeingassessment.exe","lockheedassessment.exe","colorui.exe","sysenv.exe","mt4.exe","wsapconfg.exe"]);
let UserWritablePath = dynamic([@"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\"]);
let LureExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ (LureBinaries)
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritablePath)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessId, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
LureExec
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritablePath)
    | project DllLoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, DllName = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath, DllSha256 = SHA256
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where DllLoadTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 2m)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where RemotePort in (443, 8080, 8443)
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, EgressPid = InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.EgressPid
| where isnull(EgressTime) or EgressTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 10m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, DllName, DllPath, DllSha256, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc

let LureBinaries = dynamic(["putty.exe","tightvnc.exe","amazonassessment.exe","amazonvncviewer.exe","iconcache.exe","fcccalltester.exe","mxgetinfo.exe","airbusassessment.exe","boeingassessment.exe","lockheedassessment.exe","colorui.exe","sysenv.exe","mt4.exe","wsapconfg.exe"]);
let UserWritablePath = dynamic([@"\Downloads\",@"\Desktop\",@"\Temp\",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\ProgramData\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ImageLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| extend BinaryName = tostring(split(ImageLower,"\\")[-1])
| where BinaryName in~ (LureBinaries)
| where ImageLower has_any (UserWritablePath)
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName)
| extend ParentBinary = tostring(split(ParentLower,"\\")[-1])
| where ParentBinary in~ ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, NewProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Lazarus Operation DreamJob - Trojanized Signed Binary Executed From User-Writable Path
id: 4b1c8e3a-d2f5-4a1e-9c7b-bf0d8e1a5c3f
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of Lazarus DreamJob lure binaries (trojanized PuTTY, TightVNC, AmazonAssessment, IconCache, etc.) from user-writable directories spawned by an archive utility, browser, or email client - the canonical Lazarus / Diamond Sleet LinkedIn social-engineering chain.
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/3cx-software-supply-chain-compromise
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/09/29/lazarus-luring-employees-trojanized-coding-challenges/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/lazarus-collectionrat/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\putty.exe'
      - '\tightvnc.exe'
      - '\amazonassessment.exe'
      - '\amazonvncviewer.exe'
      - '\iconcache.exe'
      - '\fcccalltester.exe'
      - '\mxgetinfo.exe'
      - '\airbusassessment.exe'
      - '\boeingassessment.exe'
      - '\lockheedassessment.exe'
      - '\colorui.exe'
      - '\sysenv.exe'
      - '\mt4.exe'
      - '\wsapconfg.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Temp\'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate evaluation of these tools after manual download. Confirm the binary SHA256 against the vendor distribution - Lazarus variants are signed with stolen certs but mismatch vendor hashes.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\putty.exe OR *\\PuTTY.exe OR *\\PUTTY.EXE OR *\\tightvnc.exe OR *\\TightVNC.exe OR *\\amazonassessment.exe OR *\\AmazonAssessment.exe OR *\\iconcache.exe OR *\\IconCache.exe OR *\\fcccalltester.exe OR *\\FCCCallTester.exe OR *\\mxgetinfo.exe OR *\\airbusassessment.exe OR *\\boeingassessment.exe OR *\\lockheedassessment.exe OR *\\colorui.exe OR *\\sysenv.exe OR *\\mt4.exe OR *\\MT4.exe OR *\\wsapconfg.exe) @Image:(*\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*) @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\7zg.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\firefox.exe) -@User:*$

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus LSASS credential dump via comsvcs.dll #-24 MiniDump (post-DreamJob credential access)
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus post-exploitation credential-access primitive: rundll32 invoking the comsvcs.dll MiniDump export (ordinal #-24) to extract LSASS memory to a writable directory. This LOLBin technique is the documented Lazarus / Hidden Cobra LSASS dump method observed in the 2023 JumpCloud breach, Operation DreamJob lateral-movement stages, and several CISA HIDDEN COBRA advisories on the AppleJeus / FASTCash chains.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" AND Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs*" AND (Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*#-24*" OR Processes.process="*#24*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rex field=cmd "MiniDump\\s+(?<dumped_pid>\\d+)(?:\\s+(?<dump_file>\\S+))?"
| table firstTime host user process_name image parent cmd dumped_pid dump_file
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#-24","#24")
| extend DumpedPid = extract(@"MiniDump\s+(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DumpFile = extract(@"MiniDump\s+\d+\s+([^\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\")
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DumpedFileName = FileName, DumpedFolder = FolderPath, DumperPid = InitiatingProcessId
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.DumperPid
| where isnull(DumpTime) or DumpTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 1m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, DumpedPid, DumpFile, DumpedFileName, DumpedFolder
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ImageLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where ImageLower endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#-24","#24")
| extend DumpedPid = extract(@"MiniDump\s+(\d+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend DumpFile = extract(@"MiniDump\s+\d+\s+([^\s]+)", 1, CommandLine)

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus LSASS Credential Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump Export
id: 7f3e2c9a-8b1d-4e5f-a2c6-d4b9e1f0c8a3
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32.exe invoking the comsvcs.dll MiniDump (ordinal #-24) export to dump LSASS memory - documented Lazarus / Hidden Cobra credential-access tradecraft observed during the JumpCloud breach and Operation DreamJob post-exploitation.
references:
  - https://us-cert.cisa.gov/ncas/analysis-reports/ar20-045a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/north-korea-supply-chain
  - https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Libraries/Comsvcs/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_dll:
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs'
  selection_export:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - '#-24'
      - '#24'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorized red-team / penetration-test activity using identical LOLBAS syntax. Verify with engagement records.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDLL32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) (@CommandLine:*comsvcs* OR @CommandLine:*COMSVCS* OR @CommandLine:*ComSvcs*) (@CommandLine:*MiniDump* OR @CommandLine:*minidump* OR @CommandLine:*MINIDUMP* OR @CommandLine:*#-24* OR @CommandLine:*#24*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i CommandLine=/comsvcs/i CommandLine=/(MiniDump|#-?24)/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: comsvcs.dll MiniDump is a generic LOLBAS, but Lazarus has institutionalized it as their default LSASS dumper - it appears in CISA HIDDEN COBRA AR20-045A, the JumpCloud post-compromise IR (2023), and ESET/Mandiant Operation DreamJob writeups. They prefer it over Mimikatz/ProcDump because comsvcs.dll is a Microsoft-signed in-box binary that bypasses many AV signatures and leaves no dropper artifact.
